name: text/headline-slam
title: Headline Slam
title_vi: Tiêu đề đập xuống, rung nhẹ khi chạm
desc_vi: Tiêu đề thu từ 1.6 lần về đúng cỡ rất dứt khoát, khung rung ba nhịp lúc chạm, rồi trôi khẽ; có thể hất bay lên ở cuối.
params_vi: landAt: thời gian đập (0.58 s) · scale: cỡ đầu (1.6) · accentWord: chỉ số từ tô màu (1, -1 = không tô) · accent: màu tô · hold: thời gian giữ có trôi (2.32 s) · drift · exit: none | up
notes: Motion ported 1:1 (slam 1.6 -> 1 expo.out over 0.58 s with opacity, shake of three 1/30 s steps at the landing: +0.55 % w / -0.3 % h, -0.38 % w / +0.2 % h, 0; drift -0.55 % h; exit y -120 % h power4.in 0.46 s; cqw/cqh -> px from ctx.W/H). NOT ported: the font fitting from the character count, the weight 900 / line-height / negative letter-spacing and the drop shadow (film's text style), the green/blue/violet token map (the accent colour is the param `accent`, default the source's green #71f5a7; `accentWord` = the source's accent_word_index, default 1, -1 = none), the flex row with 2cqw gap (words are inline-block spans separated by normal spaces). The source envelope depends on the clip duration D (default 3.5 s) and compresses IN/OUT if D < 1.18 s; here the hold is the param `hold` (default 2.32 s = 3.5 - 0.72 - 0.46) and the compression is not ported. The exit is off by default so the headline holds until the cut (the source always exits; set exit: 'up' and a matching hold for that). The effect wraps the target's text in two inline-block spans (stage for the shake, headline for scale/opacity/drift/exit). The demo's plain reference carries the same accent colour in its markup, so the end check compares like with like.
